review_summary: Exact-firmware combined patch preserves the six reviewed MTU edits, promotes only the native Classic SSP temporary classification to persistent for both pairing_cb and BTM, and serializes incoming HID interrupt requests only inside the already-busy security branch through the original deferred path. Authentication, encryption, user rejection, different-host checks and HIDD state checks remain intact. ELF layout and independent assembly verified; native behavior tests and runtime evidence are recorded separately. Three additional instruction edits force HCI Write_Class_Of_Device bytes 08 25 00 from first initialization. The input CoD argument is entirely unused; both normal pointer calls and Companion raw-class hook calls are validated. Headers, allocation, dispatch, ABI and caller buffers remain intact.

patches.rationale: Accept reports through 512 bytes; reject 513 and above.
Report the actual limit in the diagnostic.
Shared immediate initializes both control and interrupt MTUs.
Preserve min(peer MTU, local cap) semantics.
Classify Classic SSP JustWorks as persistent in both pairing_cb and the BTM record; keep user confirmation and NONE removal semantics.
Load saved is_originator instead of preparing the optional busy diagnostic.
Outgoing requests retain the original native busy security checks.
Match only incoming HID interrupt PSM 0x0013 in the busy branch.
Defer HID interrupt through the existing pending-security flag and BTM_CMD_STARTED path.
Other PSMs resume existing security logic; only one optional diagnostic is omitted.
Encode fixed controller CoD low byte 0x08 before runtime hooks are installed.
Encode fixed controller CoD middle byte 0x25 without reading or changing the caller buffer.
Encode fixed controller CoD high byte zero; the input argument is now unused.

device_preflight: Exact phone firmware and existing MTU runtime identified; this combined payload has not yet been tested on the phone.
scope_notes: Classic JustWorks persistent classification applies to this exact firmware generally, not only Nintendo-named devices.
The HID ordering edit omits one busy diagnostic message; it does not bypass the security or HIDD host/state checks.
Mode-Change hook recognition is not changed by this static payload.
While this module is enabled, every Classic Bluetooth Write_Class_Of_Device command advertises controller class 0x002508, matching Companion intent from startup.
